# A brazier's flame (generated by make_env.py), all unlit: a tall tan core and three red tongues round it.
# Origin at the coals.
new
material new Hot --base-color 0.8784 0.6431 0.4314 --no-slot
material new Flame --base-color 0.6627 0.1922 0.1882 --no-slot
add mesh cone --name Core --vertices 5 --radius1 0.200 --radius2 0.000 --depth 0.950 --location 0.000 0.000 0.475
material assign Hot
add mesh cone --name Tongue0 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.200 --radius2 0.000 --depth 0.600 --location 0.173 -0.100 0.300
material assign Flame
add mesh cone --name Tongue1 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.200 --radius2 0.000 --depth 0.600 --location -0.173 -0.100 0.300
material assign Flame
add mesh cone --name Tongue2 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.200 --radius2 0.000 --depth 0.600 --location -0.000 0.200 0.300
material assign Flame
select all
shade flat
export flame.glb
